done_when: PitchforkSignalLayer.java emits PF-HAG-L / PF-HAG-S candidate setups when price reverses before reaching the Median Line and breaks the opposite tine, with targets at ML +- channel width, covered by new unit tests in PitchforkSignalLayerTest.
goal: Implement Hagopian failure breakout candidates (PF-HAG-L / PF-HAG-S) in PitchforkSignalLayer.java per Rule P-04 in RESEARCH_PITCHFORK_LAYER.md: when price stalls before ML, reverses, and closes beyond the opposing tine, emit momentum breakout order with target equal to channel width.
note:
Documented in papers/01_MASTERS_PITCHFORK_FOUNDATIONS.md:97 and RESEARCH_PITCHFORK_LAYER.md:39. Supported in pitchfork_detector.py:190-210, but not yet implemented in PitchforkSignalLayer.java.
REVIEWED: 2026-10-28 T0-ONLY
steps: In PitchforkSignalLayer.java, add Hagopian failure detection state tracking whether price traversed >= 15% towards ML from origin tine before failing to reach ML.
When close breaches opposing tine (close > UML for ascending failure or close < LML for descending failure), emit PF-HAG-L or PF-HAG-S setup candidate.
Set entry at breach price, stop at the swing failure extreme, and target at ML +- channelWidth (measured move).
Add unit tests in PitchforkSignalLayerTest covering Hagopian long and short setups with valid R:R >= 1.5.
title: Pitchfork engine: implement Hagopian failure breakout candidates (PF-HAG-L / PF-HAG-S) in Java
